newsitem.title: USA: U.S. Robotics ships x2 technolgoy for ISPs.
newsitem.headline: U.S. Robotics ships x2 technolgoy for ISPs.

text.p: U.S. Robotics Corp said Thursday it shipped its x2 56-kilobit per second technology for its Total Control remote access server, used by Internet Service Providers and online services.
U.S. Robotics said the service providers can now download new software to upgrade their remote access servers.

U.S. Robotics has already shipped its desktop x2 modems. As there is still no standard for 56 kbps technology, online services and users must use compatible products for users to get download speeds of up to 56 kbps.
The company said the online services which support the U.S. Robotics' x2 technology have a total of more than 18 million subscribers.
U.S. Robotics said all of its remote access servers, including the Total Control Enterprise Network Hub, can be upgraded with software.
